title: Youth commission fiscal 2028 budget request
summary: In July 2026 the Commission on Children and Youth heard that budget paperwork was due by the end of September, and in August it approved a fiscal year 2028 request including $1,000 to attend a youth summit on Oʻahu in October 2027. In September the commission kept the request on its agenda to check its status at the next meeting.

timeline.text: The budget request will stay on the agenda to check its status at the next meeting.
Motion to accept the proposed fiscal year 2028 budget request: Commissioners approved the proposed fiscal year 2028 budget request as presented.
It asks for $1,000 so commissioners can attend the Hawaiʻi Children and Youth Summit on Oʻahu in October 2027.
The chair drafted a fiscal year 2028 budget request to the Department of Human Concerns.
The chair offered to draft a letter requesting funds for printed materials and training.
The secretary said any commission budget request paperwork is due by the end of September.
